title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
lede: Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, 103% higher than a year ago and above its own guidance, and told investors growth will continue without Jensen Huang.

points: Guidance had been $108 billion; the fourth quarter is forecast at $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.
The fiscal 2028 outlook rose to about 75% growth from 70%, measured from a higher base.
Kress said the outlook accounts for data center readiness, how durable demand is, and customers' access to capital.
Nvidia spent $28.1 billion on buybacks in the quarter and has $227.3 billion left to use.
Kress said memory and advanced packaging capacity are secured, and Nvidia is working with TSMC to narrow supply gaps.

sections.text: Secured memory and packaging plus work with TSMC on supply suggest Nvidia expects to keep shipping at pace, which bears on how much accelerator capacity reaches the teams that buy or rent it.
